Recording of the vocal meeting of 2014-12-28 which occured on Mumble. The motive of this meeting was to attempt to play vocally to the 20 questions game.

Participants: Ilmen, la .iadzncta (aka la cirko), la gleki, la nejni marji, Mungojelly (la selckiku) and la tsani.

Duration: The recording is 1 hour 6 minutes long, but silences have been removed; the actual meeting lasted for nearly two hours in actuality.
